feat(design-release-2-1-transporters): The transporter list refuses a save with no transporter chosen
feat(design-release-2-1-transporters): Each transporter on the list links to its details page
feat(design-release-2-1-transporters): Transporter tab: transporters listed with approval number and type, and filtered by type
feat(design-release-2-1-transporters): The commercial transporter form's heading, guidance banner, postcode copy and required fields
feat(design-release-2-1-transporters): The private transporter's country list is the United Kingdom plus reference data's export countries, as the master data serves them
feat(design-release-2-1-transporters): The private transporter form's heading, country select and required fields

scenarios.heading: The View link on a transporter row opens that transporter's own page

steps.text: the organisation's address book holds a transporter
the user follows the View link on its row in the Transporter tab
a page headed with that transporter's name shows its record
the URL names the transporter, not an address

scenarios.heading: A commercial transporter's page shows its approval number and a private transporter's does not

steps.text: the user opens a commercial transporter
the page is shown
its approval number is listed against its label, and its type reads 'Commercial'
the user opens a private transporter
the page is shown
no approval number row is shown, and its type reads 'Private'

scenarios.heading: The page offers to edit or delete the transporter being viewed

steps.text: the user is viewing a transporter
the page is shown
an action to edit and an action to delete that same transporter are both offered

scenarios.heading: Back from a transporter's page returns to the address book on the Transporter tab

steps.text: the user is viewing a transporter opened without a return
they select Back
they return to the address book filtered to the Transporter tab

scenarios.heading: A transporter that is not live returns the user to the address book

steps.text: an id that holds no live transporter in the organisation's address book, whether deleted, never created, or belonging to another organisation
the user opens the transporter page for it
they are returned to the address book, and the attempt is logged once

scenarios.heading: The edit form opens holding the stored values and does not ask the type again

steps.text: the organisation's address book holds a private transporter
the user opens its edit form
every field holds the stored value
no transporter type question is asked

scenarios.heading: Saving an edit replaces the record and confirms it by name

steps.text: the user is editing a transporter and changes its name
they save it
a 'Success' banner reads '<new name> updated in your address book'
the address book opens on the Transporter tab showing the transporter under its new name

scenarios.heading: An optional field left blank on an edit is cleared

steps.text: a transporter holding an address line 2 and a county
the user clears both on the edit form and saves
the stored transporter holds neither, and its page shows no row for either

scenarios.heading: A commercial transporter's fixed country and required approval number hold on edit

steps.text: the user is editing a commercial transporter
the form is shown
its country is fixed to Northern Ireland and cannot be changed
they clear the approval number and save
the save is refused, naming the approval number

scenarios.heading: Cancelling an edit leaves the stored transporter as it was

steps.text: the user has changed a field on a transporter's edit form without saving
they cancel
the stored transporter is unchanged, and they return to the address book on the Transporter tab

scenarios.heading: Editing a transporter that is not live returns the user to the address book

steps.text: an id that holds no live transporter in the organisation's address book
the user opens or submits its edit form
they are returned to the address book, nothing is changed, and the attempt is logged once

scenarios.heading: The delete page summarises the transporter before it is deleted

steps.text: the user has chosen to delete a transporter
the confirmation page is shown
it names the transporter and summarises its details
it offers an action to confirm the deletion and a way to cancel

scenarios.heading: Confirming the deletion removes it from the list and confirms it by name

steps.text: the user is on a transporter's delete confirmation page
they confirm the deletion
a 'Success' banner reads '<name> deleted from your address book'
the address book opens on the Transporter tab without that transporter

scenarios.heading: Cancelling the deletion leaves the transporter in the address book

steps.text: the user is on a transporter's delete confirmation page
they cancel
the transporter is still in the address book on the Transporter tab

scenarios.heading: Deleting a transporter that is not live returns the user to the address book

steps.text: an id that holds no live transporter in the organisation's address book
the user opens or submits its delete confirmation
they are returned to the address book, nothing is changed, and the attempt is logged once

scenarios.heading: Each role-backed tab offers Select one and then its own Types, and the Transporter tab offers Commercial and Private

steps.text: the user is viewing the address book
they look at the Type select on each tab in turn
'Origin and Consignor' offers 'Select one', 'Place of Origin' and 'Consignor'
'Destination, Consignee and Importer' offers 'Select one', 'Consignee', 'Importer' and 'Place of Destination'
'Branch' offers 'Select one' and 'Branch Address'
the 'Transporter' tab offers 'Select one', 'Commercial' and 'Private', in that order

scenarios.heading: A Type on the Transporter tab lists only that type's transporters, counted across the whole category

steps.text: the 'Transporter' tab runs past one page, and two commercial transporters matching a search lie beyond the first page among private ones that also match
the user submits the search with 'Commercial' chosen
only the two commercial transporters are listed and the list reads 'Showing 1-2 of 2'
no pagination is shown

scenarios.heading: The same search field matches a transporter by its name, address, type, country or approval number

steps.text: the user is on the Transporter tab
they search by a transporter's name, its address, its type, its country, or its approval number where it has one
only the matching transporters are shown
the not-applicable word shown for a transporter with no approval number is never itself matched

scenarios.heading: The four tabs are shown in order with the selected one marked

steps.text: the user is signed in
they view the address book
the tabs 'Origin and Consignor', 'Destination, Consignee and Importer', 'Transporter' and 'Branch' are shown in that order
the selected tab is marked

scenarios.heading: The Type column names the address's roles and the columns are the same on every role-backed tab

steps.text: the address book holds an address with the roles place of origin and consignor
the user views the tab that lists it
its Type reads 'Place of origin, Consignor'
the columns are Name, Type, Address, Country and Action, with the Action heading visually hidden

scenarios.heading: The Transporter tab's columns show a commercial transporter's approval number and the not-applicable word on a private one

steps.text: the organisation has added a commercial transporter with an approval number and a private transporter
the user views the 'Transporter' tab
the columns are Name, Address, Approval number and Type, with the Action heading visually hidden
the commercial transporter's Approval number cell shows its stored number
the private transporter's Approval number cell reads 'Not applicable'
each transporter's Address cell ends with its country

scenarios.heading: Each role-backed tab offers Select one and then its own Types, and the Transporter tab offers Commercial and Private

steps.text: the user is viewing the address book
they look at the Type select on each tab in turn
'Origin and Consignor' offers 'Select one', 'Place of Origin' and 'Consignor'
'Destination, Consignee and Importer' offers 'Select one', 'Consignee', 'Importer' and 'Place of Destination'
'Branch' offers 'Select one' and 'Branch Address'
the 'Transporter' tab offers 'Select one', 'Commercial' and 'Private', in that order

scenarios.heading: The address type page offers the four types with their hints

steps.text: the user is on the address book
they choose 'Add a new address'
'Choose an address type' opens under the caption 'Add a new address', with a 'Continue' button and a 'Back' link to the address book

the options are 'Origin or Consignor' with the hint 'Place of origin, Consignor', 'Destination, Consignee or Importer' with the hint 'Place of destination, Consignee, Importer', 'Transporter' with the hint 'Private, Commercial' and 'Branch' with the hint 'Branch address', in that order and with none chosen
the options sit in a group whose legend repeats the heading for screen readers

scenarios.heading: Choosing Transporter opens the add-a-transporter pages instead of the add form

steps.text: the user is on 'Choose an address type'
they choose 'Transporter' and select 'Continue'
the add-a-transporter pages open, not the address add form

scenarios.heading: Opening or saving the add form with Transporter chosen opens the address type question and saves nothing

steps.text: 'Transporter' is the address type stored from an earlier visit to 'Choose an address type'
the user opens the address add form directly, or posts a save to it
'Choose an address type' opens instead
nothing is saved

scenarios.heading: The transporter type question shows its caption, heading, warning, options and Continue

steps.text: the user has chosen 'Transporter' on 'Choose an address type'
the transporter type question opens
it is captioned 'Add a new transporter' and headed 'Choose a transporter type'
it warns 'Check the transporter list before adding new transporters to avoid duplicates.'
it offers 'Private transporter' and 'Commercial', the second hinted 'This can only be a commercial transporter from Northern Ireland.', and a 'Continue' button

scenarios.heading: Back returns to the address type question

steps.text: the user is on the transporter type question, reached from the address book
they select 'Back'
'Choose an address type' opens

scenarios.heading: Continuing with nothing chosen shows the refusal and stores no type

steps.text: the user is on the transporter type question with neither option chosen
they select 'Continue'
'Select what kind of transporter it is' shows against the options and in the summary
the summary link focuses 'Private transporter'
no transporter type is stored

scenarios.heading: Private opens the private form and Commercial the commercial form

steps.text: the user is on the transporter type question
they choose 'Private transporter' and select 'Continue'
the private transporter form opens
the user is on the transporter type question
they choose 'Commercial' and select 'Continue'
the commercial transporter form opens

scenarios.heading: Opening a form without its type chosen returns to the type question

steps.text: the user has chosen no transporter type, or has chosen the other one
they open the private transporter form or the commercial transporter form directly
the transporter type question opens instead

scenarios.heading: The private transporter form shows its fields

steps.text: the user is on the private transporter form
the page is shown
it asks for 'Name or organisation', 'Address line 1', 'Address line 2 (optional)', 'Town or city', 'County (optional)', 'Postcode or Zip code', 'Country', 'Email address' and 'Phone number'
the address fields sit under 'Address' and the email and phone fields under 'Contact details'

scenarios.heading: The commercial transporter form shows its fields and the fixed country

steps.text: the user is on the commercial transporter form
the page is shown
it asks for 'Name or organisation', 'Approval number', 'Address line 1', 'Address line 2 (optional)', 'Town or city', 'County (optional)', 'Postcode or Zip code', 'Email address' and 'Phone number'
the country shows as 'Northern Ireland', fixed rather than offered as a choice

scenarios.heading: A tampered country is refused

steps.text: the commercial transporter form's fixed country field has been tampered with to post a different country
the form is saved
the save is refused, naming that a commercial transporter must be in Northern Ireland
nothing is created

scenarios.heading: Cancel with partial values entered saves nothing

steps.text: the user has entered some fields on the private transporter form, or on the commercial transporter form
they follow 'Cancel and return to address book'
they land on the address book filtered to the Transporter tab
no transporter holding what they entered exists in their organisation's address book

scenarios.heading: Saving a private transporter shows the success banner and lists it first

steps.text: the user has filled in a valid private transporter form
they save it
a 'Success' banner reads '<name> added to your address book'
the address book opens on the Transporter tab with the new transporter listed first, its type reading 'Private' and its Approval number cell reading 'Not applicable'

scenarios.heading: Saving a commercial transporter shows the success banner and lists it first with its approval number

steps.text: the user has filled in a valid commercial transporter form
they save it
a 'Success' banner reads '<name> added to your address book'
the address book opens on the Transporter tab with the new transporter listed first, its type reading 'Commercial' and its Approval number cell reading its stored approval number

scenarios.heading: A created transporter is scoped to its organisation

steps.text: a transporter is created for one organisation
another organisation lists its transporters, or looks the transporter up by id
it is absent from the list, and the lookup by id is refused as not found

scenarios.heading: A transporter type outside private and commercial is refused

steps.text: a transporter is created with a type that is neither private nor commercial
the service refuses it naming the type

scenarios.heading: An approval number is required for commercial and refused for private

steps.text: a commercial transporter is created with no approval number
the service refuses it naming the approval number
a private transporter is created carrying an approval number
the service refuses it naming the approval number

scenarios.heading: A commercial transporter's country must be Northern Ireland

steps.text: a commercial transporter is created with a country other than Northern Ireland
the service refuses it naming the country
a private transporter is created with any country
it is accepted

scenarios.heading: The organisation's live transporters are listed newest first

steps.text: an organisation has added two transporters, one after the other
its transporters are listed
the more recently added transporter is returned first

scenarios.heading: The list is searchable and narrowable

steps.text: an organisation's transporters include one matching a search term in its name, address lines, town, county, postcode or approval number
the list is searched for that term
only the matching transporter is returned
transporters of both types
the list is narrowed to one type or one country code
only the transporters of that type, or in that country, are returned

scenarios.heading: A deleted transporter is tombstoned, not removed

steps.text: a transporter exists
it is deleted
it no longer appears in the organisation's list
it can still be fetched by its own id, marked deleted, with its details intact

scenarios.heading: Cancelling an add of the other type keeps the record the earlier type held

steps.text: the user has added a private transporter through the add route
they add a transporter again, choose "Commercial", and cancel that form without saving it
adding again and choosing "Private" shows the private transporter details form holding the details they entered, because no change of type was saved

scenarios.heading: Continuing with nothing chosen is refused

steps.text: the user is on the transporter list
they press "Save and continue" with nothing chosen
they stay on the list with "Select a transporter from the list" in a "There is a problem" summary linking to the first transporter option and shown inline above the table

scenarios.heading: Returning to overview with nothing chosen is refused the same way

steps.text: the user is on the transporter list
they press "Save and return to overview" with nothing chosen
they stay on the list with the same summary and the same inline error
the notification's transporter is left as it was

scenarios.heading: Every row carries a named "View details" link

steps.text: the user is on the transporter list
the page loads
every row ends with a "View details" link whose visually hidden text names that row's own transporter

scenarios.heading: Following it shows the record; Back returns to this list

steps.text: the user has added a transporter through the address book
they follow its "View details" link
a page headed with that transporter's name shows its record
following its Back link returns to this same transporter list

scenarios.heading: The page carries the same authorisation guidance as the list, in a banner titled "Important"

steps.text: the user has reached the commercial transporter details page
the page loads
it shows a notification banner titled "Important" whose content opens with the heading "Help with transporter authorisation"
the banner goes on to state the same transporter-authorisation guidance the transporter list carries, including the link to further guidance

scenarios.heading: An over-length Postcode or Zip code is refused with the message that names the field as the form labels it

steps.text: the user has entered a Postcode or Zip code longer than 12 characters
they try to save
the save is blocked and the error reads "Postcode or Zip code must be 12 characters or less"

scenarios.heading: Saving a wholly blank form is refused, naming every required field in order

steps.text: the user is on the commercial transporter details page with every field blank
they save and continue

the save is refused, the trader stays on the form, and the error summary lists, in order: "Enter a transporter authorisation number", "Enter a name or organisation name", "Enter address line 1", "Enter a town or city", "Enter a postcode or Zip code", "Enter an email address", "Enter a phone number"

scenarios.heading: A private transporter's saved country shows on the review

steps.text: a private transporter has been saved with a country from the offered list
the user views the review
the Transport details card's Country row shows that country

scenarios.heading: Returning to Private after adding as Commercial shows the private form blank, Country select back on the United Kingdom

steps.text: the user has added a private transporter through the add route
they add a transporter again, choose "Commercial" and save, then add again and choose "Private"
the private transporter details form is shown with every field blank and the Country select back on the United Kingdom, not the previously entered details

scenarios.heading: The Country select opens on the United Kingdom among country names in alphabetical order

steps.text: the user reaches the private transporter details page
the page loads
the Country select shows the United Kingdom chosen
every option is a country name, listed in alphabetical order with the United Kingdom in its alphabetical place

scenarios.heading: An invalid country blocks the save and reopens the select on the United Kingdom, rather than preserving

steps.text: the user has entered a country not in the offered list for the private transporter's address, alongside valid values in every other field
they try to save
the save is blocked, the error names the country, the Country select shows the United Kingdom, and every other field still shows what was entered

scenarios.heading: Saving a wholly blank form is refused, naming every required field in order

steps.text: the user is on the private transporter details page with every field blank
they save and continue
the save is refused, the trader stays on the form, and the error summary lists the six required messages in the page's own field order

scenarios.heading: Completing the details saves them and returns to the transporter list, chosen

steps.text: the user is on the commercial transporter details page with every mandatory field entered
they save and continue
they return to the transporter list, with the saved transporter already chosen

scenarios.heading: The save puts the trader straight on the list with the new transporter checked, surviving the list's own save

steps.text: the user has just saved a complete set of commercial transporter details
the save lands
the transporter list is shown with that transporter's row checked, with no need to open the list separately to find it so
they save the list without changing the choice
they return to Overview, and the commercial transporter form still shows the saved authorisation number

scenarios.heading: The page offers exactly the primary and the cancel control

steps.text: the user is on the commercial transporter details page
the page loads
it ends with exactly "Save and continue" and a secondary "Cancel and return to dashboard", and offers no link back to the overview

scenarios.heading: Cancelling with the stored type unchanged leaves the chosen transporter alone and shows no error

steps.text: the user already has a commercial transporter chosen, and reaches the commercial transporter details page with some or all fields filled in
they choose "Cancel and return to dashboard"
no error is shown, no transporter is added, and they are taken to the dashboard
the transporter they had chosen before the add began is still chosen on the transporter list

scenarios.heading: Leaving a refused form and returning to it shows what was entered

steps.text: the user's save of the commercial transporter details was refused for a missing or invalid field
they leave the page and later open it again
the values they had entered are shown in the fields, not the previously saved answer

scenarios.heading: Completing the details saves them and returns to the transporter list, chosen

steps.text: the user is on the private transporter details page with the name entered
they complete every mandatory address field and save and continue
they return to the transporter list, with the saved transporter already chosen

scenarios.heading: The save puts the trader straight on the list with the new transporter checked, surviving the list's own save

steps.text: the user has just saved a complete set of private transporter details
the save lands
the transporter list is shown with that transporter's row checked
they save the list without changing the choice
they return to Overview, and the private transporter form still shows the saved name, country and email address

scenarios.heading: The page offers exactly the primary and the cancel control

steps.text: the user is on the private transporter details page
the page loads
it ends with exactly "Save and continue" and a secondary "Cancel and return to dashboard", and offers no link back to the overview

scenarios.heading: Cancelling with the stored type unchanged leaves the chosen transporter alone and shows no error

steps.text: the user already has a transporter of the private type chosen, and reaches the private transporter details page with some or all fields filled in
they choose "Cancel and return to dashboard"
no error is shown, no transporter is added, and they are taken to the dashboard
the transporter they had chosen before the add began is still chosen on the transporter list

scenarios.heading: Leaving a refused form and returning to it shows what was entered

steps.text: the user's save of the private transporter details was refused for a missing or invalid field
they leave the page and later open it again
the values they had entered are shown in the fields, not the previously saved answer

scenarios.heading: The list returns with the added transporter first, checked, and names it in the banner

steps.text: the user has saved a complete private or commercial transporter from its add form
the save lands back on the transporter list
the added transporter is the first row shown, with its radio checked
a success notification banner titled "Success" reads the transporter's name, with only its first letter capitalised, followed by " transporter added"

scenarios.heading: Reloading the list, or returning to it later, shows it with no banner

steps.text: the transporter list has just shown the added-transporter banner
the user reloads the list, or leaves and comes back to it later
the list is shown with no banner

scenarios.heading: Opening the private transporter form without the private type chosen lands on the type question

steps.text: the notification's saved transporter type is not Private, or no type is saved
the user opens or posts to the private transporter form
the transporter type question is shown instead
nothing is saved

scenarios.heading: Opening the commercial transporter form without the commercial type chosen lands on the type question

steps.text: the notification's saved transporter type is not Commercial, or no type is saved
the user opens or posts to the commercial transporter form
the transporter type question is shown instead
nothing is saved

scenarios.heading: The page carries the new-transporter caption and duplicate-check warning

steps.text: the user has selected "Add a transporter" from the transporter list
the type question is shown
it is captioned to show it is part of adding a new transporter
it warns the trader to check the transporter list before adding a new transporter, to avoid duplicates

scenarios.heading: Continuing with nothing chosen is refused

steps.text: the user is on the transporter type page
they continue without choosing a type
they stay on the page with "Select a transporter type" in a "There is a problem" summary linking to the first option and shown inline above the radios
the transporter type already saved on the notification, if any, is unchanged

scenarios.heading: A submitted type the page does not offer is refused

steps.text: the user is on the transporter type page
the submitted transporter type is neither Private nor Commercial
they stay on the page with "Select a transporter type" in a "There is a problem" summary linking to the first option and shown inline above the radios
the transporter type already saved on the notification, if any, is unchanged

scenarios.heading: The transporter list and the commercial transporter form show the state and reference; the type question and the private transporter form show neither

steps.text: a notification being worked on
the user opens the transporter list or the commercial transporter form
the notification's state and reference are shown
the user opens the transporter type question or the private transporter form
neither is shown

scenarios.heading: A transporter the organisation added through the address book is on the list and can be picked

steps.text: the organisation has added a transporter through the address book
the user opens the transporter list on their next notification
that transporter is shown as a row, tagged "New"
the user can choose it and save

scenarios.heading: Searching for the words shown where a transporter has no approval number leaves exactly those transporters

steps.text: the user is on the transporter list
they search for the words the Approval number column shows for a transporter without one
only the transporters with no approval number are shown
they search for a real approval number instead
only the transporter it belongs to is shown

scenarios.heading: The heading and the group share the one name

steps.text: the user is on the transporter list
the page loads
"Select a transporter" is shown once as a heading above the search box and the table
the transporter choices are offered as one group named "Select a transporter"

scenarios.heading: The list has no serious or critical accessibility violations, plain or with a refused pick

steps.text: the user is on the transporter list with nothing chosen
the page loads
the page has no serious or critical accessibility violations
the user submits a transporter that is not on the list
the page, now showing the error summary and the in-fieldset error message, has no serious or critical accessibility violations
